q: What happens if we miss the target in a sustainability-linked loan?
title: Missing a sustainability-linked loan target
short: Usually the interest margin steps up or a discount is lost for the next period. Missing a target is not normally a default, but failing to report or verify the KPI can breach the loan terms. Read the margin and reporting clauses before signing.
audience: MSMEs and mid-size companies with or considering sustainability-linked loans

ul: A margin increase, or loss of a margin reduction, for the following period.
Disclosure of the miss in the annual KPI report.
No change to repayment, unless the loan says otherwise.

p: Most loans require yearly KPI reporting and external verification. Missing that obligation is usually treated more seriously than missing the target itself.

ul: Check how the KPI is measured and which data it uses.
Agree how the baseline is recalculated if you grow or buy a unit.
Set targets you can track monthly, not only at year end.

senseible: Senseible turns invoices and bills into dated, fingerprinted emission records, the evidence a lender usually asks to see first.
